stories.title: Denver scored 151, the NBA's most this season, behind Murray's 45
stories.dek: Nikola Jokic added 37 points, 18 rebounds and 11 assists in the 151-145 overtime win over Chicago.
stories.hero_stat: 151 points, the most by any NBA team this season; Murray 45, Jokic 37-18-11

stories.title: The Warriors ended a 5-game skid by holding Boston to a season-low 87 points
stories.dek: Golden State won 88-87 after losing 5 straight on the road; Boston shot 39% and scored 12 points in the 4th quarter.
stories.hero_stat: 88-87; Boston's 87 is its fewest in 17 games this season

stories.title: The 2-14 Kings ended an 8-game skid by beating the 11-5 Celtics 97-96
stories.dek: Keegan Murray's tip-in with 5.0 seconds left won it; Boston shot 13-of-58 from 3-point range.
stories.hero_stat: 97-96, Murray's tip with 5.0 seconds left

stories.title: Wembanyama scored 50 with 5 blocks after a 32-point first half
stories.dek: He added 19 rebounds and 4 steals in a 114-91 win over New Orleans, and his first half was a play-by-play-era first.
stories.hook: Wembanyama makes history in 18 minutes, finishes game with 50 points
stories.hero_stat: 50 points, 19 rebounds, 5 blocks, 4 steals

stories.title: Jokic's 24-point second half followed a 2-point first half
stories.dek: Jokic had 18 in the third quarter alone as Denver beat Houston 133-124.
stories.hook: Nikola Jokic's big second half sends the Nuggets to a 133-124 win over the Rockets
stories.hero_stat: 24 second-half points after 2 in the first half

stories.title: Scottie Barnes scored 29 as the Raptors ended a 6-game skid at Detroit
stories.dek: Toronto's 105-102 win came on the road against a 10-5 Pistons team, and Barnes shot 14 of 21 from the field.
stories.hook: Scottie Barnes scores 29, including key layup, as Raptors end skid with 105-102 win over Pistons
stories.hero_stat: 29 points on 14-of-21 shooting in a 105-102 win

stories.title: The Warriors have lost 5 straight, all on the road, by 23.2 points a game
stories.dek: Golden State has scored under 100 points in 4 of the 5 losses, and its last 5-game skid ended in March 2026.
stories.hero_stat: 5 straight losses, all on the road, by 23.2 points a game

stories.title: The Bucks are 1-14, worse through 15 games than the 15-67 team
stories.dek: Milwaukee has lost 11 straight, matching the 15-67 team's longest skid, and the 11 losses have come by 15.9 points a game.
stories.hero_stat: 1-14 — worse through 15 games than the 15-67 team

stories.title: Jalen Johnson's 2nd triple-double in 5 days ended OKC's perfect home record
stories.dek: Johnson had 16 points, 12 rebounds and 11 assists as the Hawks won 117-112 at Oklahoma City, where the Thunder had been 5-0.
stories.hero_stat: 16 points, 12 rebounds, 11 assists — Johnson's 2nd triple-double in 5 days

stories.title: Quentin Grimes scored 47 with 10 threes, joining Kobe Bryant in Lakers history
stories.dek: The career-high 47, with 21 in the 4th quarter, rallied the Lakers from 18 down for their 9th straight win.
stories.hero_stat: 47 points, 10 threes — 2nd Laker ever with 10 in a game

stories.title: Brice Sensabaugh scored 40 off the bench as the Jazz ended a 12-game skid
stories.dek: Sensabaugh scored 25 in the 4th quarter, and Utah outscored the Clippers 44-21 in the period.
stories.hero_stat: 40 points off the bench, 25 in the 4th quarter

stories.title: Memphis has scored 129 or more in 3 straight games, its longest run this season
stories.dek: The Grizzlies average 135.7 points over the 3 games, 14.0 more than their season average.
stories.hero_stat: 135.7 points a game over 3 games, 16.9 above what those opponents usually allow

stories.title: Orlando has won 4 straight, handing Boston its first home loss
stories.dek: The Magic were 2-7 before the streak, and the win in Boston came after 3 wins over the league's 3 worst teams.
stories.hero_stat: 4 straight wins after a 2-7 start, including Boston's first home loss

stories.title: 7 days after losing by 51, New Orleans beat Golden State by 21
stories.dek: The 72-point swing ended New Orleans' 6-game losing streak and handed Golden State a 3rd straight loss.
stories.hero_stat: 72-point swing in 7 days, from a 51-point loss to a 21-point win

stories.title: Boston now leads the NBA in point differential
stories.dek: The Celtics' 37-point win over Dallas moved them past San Antonio to plus-13.1 a game, and they allow a league-low 102.4.
stories.hero_stat: plus-13.1 points a game — best differential in the NBA

stories.title: Houston scored 147 points, the most by any NBA team this season
stories.dek: The Rockets beat Washington 147-119 with 6 players in double figures and none scoring more than 26.
stories.hero_stat: 147 points — the most by any NBA team this season

stories.title: Tyrese Proctor's first triple-double: 24 points, 11 rebounds, 10 assists
stories.dek: Proctor posted 24 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists in Cleveland's 127-117 win over Dallas, his first career triple-double.
stories.hero_stat: 24 points, 11 rebounds, 10 assists — his first career triple-double

stories.title: Giannis and Bam each scored 37, the 2nd Heat duo to each score 35-plus
stories.dek: The pair combined for 74 points on 28-of-39 shooting in Miami's 133-121 win over Cleveland, the Heat's 3rd straight win after an 0-4 start.
stories.hero_stat: 37 points each — the 2nd Heat duo to each score 35-plus

stories.title: Spurs hold opponents 10.3 points below their norm during 11-game win streak
stories.dek: Golden State scored 85 points on Friday, 34.3 below its average in its other games and the Warriors' lowest total of the season by 20.
stories.hero_stat: 104.6 points allowed a game during the 11-game win streak

stories.title: Cade Cunningham posts the NBA's first 50-point, 10-assist, 0-turnover game
stories.dek: He scored 30 of his 52 points in the 4th quarter and the overtimes, and his previous career high was 46.
stories.hero_stat: 52 points, 11 assists, 0 turnovers

stories.title: Minnesota leads the NBA at plus-13.4 points a game through 12 games
stories.dek: The Timberwolves have won 5 straight by 16.4 points a game, including a 39-point rout of Dallas.
stories.hero_stat: plus-13.4 points a game, best in the NBA

stories.title: Towns has a double-double in all 11 games, tying a Knicks record
stories.dek: He averages 13.5 rebounds, the league's best, and no other player has more than 9 double-doubles.
stories.hook: Karl-Anthony Towns ties Willis Reed's Knicks record with his 11th straight double-double
stories.hero_stat: 11 double-doubles in 11 games

stories.title: The Bucks are 1-10, their worst start through 11 games in 23 seasons
stories.dek: Milwaukee has lost 7 straight by 20.3 points a game, its 2nd 7-game skid in 12 months.
stories.hero_stat: 1-10 through 11 games

stories.title: The Knicks allow 102.3 points a game through 10 games, the fewest in the NBA
stories.dek: New York started 0-3 while allowing 108.0 a game, then won 6 of 7 allowing 99.9.
stories.hero_stat: 102.3 points allowed per game

stories.title: The Warriors beat New Orleans by 51, the NBA's largest margin this season
stories.dek: Golden State won 138-87 with nobody playing more than 27 minutes, and no Pelican scored more than 12 points.
stories.hero_stat: 51-point win, the NBA's largest margin this season

stories.title: Victor Wembanyama had 40 points and 9 blocks in 25 minutes
stories.dek: The 40 points came on 15-of-19 shooting, 5 days after his 52-point game against Dallas, and the Spurs have won 9 straight.
stories.hook: Victor Wembanyama scores 40 points in 25 minutes as Spurs win 9th straight
stories.hero_stat: 40 points and 9 blocks in 25 minutes

stories.title: The Lakers score 121.9 a game through 11 games, the most in the NBA
stories.dek: Los Angeles has scored 115 or more in 9 of 11 games, including 121 without Luka Doncic on Sunday.
stories.hero_stat: 121.9 points per game

stories.title: Stephen Curry scored 41 to pass Gilgeous-Alexander for 2nd in scoring
stories.dek: Curry averages 31.2 points a game, behind only Doncic's 40.1, as the Warriors won their 7th straight.
stories.hero_stat: 41 points on 13-of-19 shooting

stories.title: Luka Doncic is averaging 40.1 points through 9 games, the first since Wilt
stories.dek: His 53 points against Portland on Friday gave him 361 points in 9 games, 10.2 clear of the NBA's next scorer.
stories.hero_stat: 40.1 points per game through 9 games

stories.title: The Spurs have won 7 straight after losing their first 2 games
stories.dek: Victor Wembanyama's career-high 52 points beat Dallas by 1, and San Antonio now owns the NBA's longest win streak.
stories.hero_stat: 7 straight wins after a 0-2 start

stories.title: The 8-1 76ers have the NBA's best record with its 9th-best point differential
stories.dek: 7 of Philadelphia's 8 wins have come by 11 points or fewer, and 5 of them by 6 or fewer.
stories.hero_stat: 8-1, the NBA's best record, on a plus-5.8 differential

stories.title: Luka Doncic is averaging 38.5 points a game, 8.4 clear of the NBA's next scorer
stories.dek: He has scored 40 or more in 5 of his 8 games, and his 5.9 3-pointers a game also lead the league.
stories.hero_stat: 38.5 points per game, 8.4 clear of the next scorer

stories.title: No NBA team is unbeaten after Memphis lost 135-134 to New Orleans
stories.dek: Memphis was the league's last unbeaten team, and the best records in the NBA are now 7-1.
stories.hero_stat: No unbeaten team remains; best records are 7-1

stories.title: The Grizzlies are 6-0, the NBA's only unbeaten team
stories.dek: Memphis beat Sacramento 136-105, and its plus-15.2 point differential leads the league.
stories.hero_stat: 6-0, plus-91 point differential

stories.title: The Pistons allow 101.8 points a game, the fewest in the NBA
stories.dek: Detroit is 5-1 after holding Brooklyn to 94 points, and no opponent has scored more than 113 against it.
stories.hero_stat: 101.8 points allowed per game, fewest of 30

stories.title: The Timberwolves' plus-14.8 point differential leads the NBA
stories.dek: Minnesota is 4-2 after beating the Clippers 127-101, and its 89-point total margin is the league's largest.
stories.hero_stat: plus-14.8 points per game, best of 30 teams

stories.title: The Grizzlies are 5-0, joining the Rockets as the NBA's only unbeaten teams
stories.dek: Memphis beat Portland 124-103, holding a team that entered the night averaging 129.3 points to 103.
stories.hero_stat: 5-0, plus-60 point differential

stories.title: The Kings are 0-5, the NBA's only winless team after losing to New Orleans
stories.dek: Sacramento lost 132-120 to a Pelicans team that entered the night 0-4, and has the league's worst per-game differential at minus-16.6.
stories.hero_stat: 0-5, minus-16.6 points per game

stories.title: The Rockets are 5-0, the NBA's only team with 5 wins
stories.dek: Houston has outscored opponents 615-544, a plus-71 differential, after a 132-100 win at Milwaukee.
stories.hero_stat: 5-0, plus-71 point differential

stories.title: The Celtics won by 35 points, then by 1 the next night
stories.dek: Boston beat Chicago 134-99, then beat Brooklyn 125-124 in overtime behind Jayson Tatum's 40 points.
stories.hero_stat: 35-point win, then a 1-point overtime win

stories.title: The Trail Blazers score 129.3 points a game, the most in the NBA
stories.dek: Portland is 3-0 after a 136-129 win at Los Angeles, the highest-scoring game of the last 2 nights.
stories.hero_stat: 129.3 points per game, 1st of 30

stories.title: The Thunder are 4-0 and allow 100.8 points a game, fewest in the NBA
stories.dek: Their 4 opponents averaged 117.4 points in their other games and 100.8 against Oklahoma City.
stories.hero_stat: 100.8 points allowed per game, 1st of 30
